records.subject: Sorry to see you go
records.body:

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Quartz Works!
records.body:
Hi Felix,

Your workspace for Quartz Works is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to three outbound emails (email:ee7ad9da, email:7f02f56f, email:7d5e279d). No tickets, so no signal of active engagement. Silent, fully unstarted Starter accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: One quick step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Felix,

I haven't heard back, so I'll keep this short. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them — so creating one real project is the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like a guided path.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything about how your team at Quartz Works would use it.

Best,
Priya
